name: @intellectual-frontiers/integrations-identity
description: Read-only connectors for the identity and device posture of a managed service provider's customers: a Microsoft Entra tenant (who has multifactor authentication, whether a policy requires it), Microsoft Intune managed devices (compliance, encryption, staleness) and a Google Workspace domain (two-step verification, administrators), each written against the read port of Integrations, with its governance as data and a conformance run over recorded answers.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/
